notes: Every AO shows where its forces stand: Deploying, Moving in, Assuming control or Occupied. Each brigade shows how many companies are deploying, staging in Kuwait, moving north, assuming control or in control
The AO screen lists every company with its status and where it is or is heading
No more stragglers: companies of an AO brigade still sitting in Kuwait or at another base outside the AO get moved in every day until they are inside. Staging in Kuwait is not their home base
